result.stdout:
Octeka.Mirror v1.4.0
Package Installer, Launcher, and Auto-Updater
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
── USAGE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Usage: mirror [options] [command]

── COMMANDS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

run          Launch an application package in a separate process or embedded
             ALC.
install      Install an application package and generate proxy stubs into the
             target bin directory.
uninstall    Uninstall an application package and clean up proxy stubs and
             cached data.
update       Update an installed tool, service, or Mirror itself to the latest
             or specified version.
check        Check remote feeds for available updates for an application
             package.
search       Search remote package feeds for available tools and applications.
list         List locally installed application packages and proxy stubs, or
             search available packages.

── OPTIONS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-nologo, --nologo    Suppress logo and banner output.
-h, --help           Show help and usage information.
